learningConfirm.title: Start automatic learning?
learningConfirm.body:
In automatic learning mode SimpleDeFence allows all traffic and remembers which applications used the network, then adds exceptions for them when you leave the mode. Rules cannot be learned for Special Exceptions.

Only use this on a system you are confident is free of malware.

general.languageDescription: Overrides the system language for SimpleDeFence's own UI.
general.askForExceptionDetails: Ask for details when adding a single exception
general.askForExceptionDetailsDescription: Show an editable confirmation before adding one exception via the tray's quick-add shortcuts. Bulk adds (e.g. a whole folder) never prompt.
general.enableHotkeysDescription: Ctrl+Alt+E/P/W instantly whitelist an executable, process, or window from anywhere.
general.autoRefreshIntervalDescription: How often the Connections page re-checks while its Auto-refresh switch is on. Nothing pushes changes to it, so this is a polling interval; lower is fresher and costs more.

protection.allowLocalSubnetDescription: Always allow traffic to and from other devices on your local network.
protection.displayOffBlock: Block network when display is off
protection.displayOffBlockDescription: Blocks all network traffic while the screen is off.

blocklists.enableDescription: Blocks traffic to known-malicious hosts and ports.

security.lockHostsFileDescription: Prevents other programs from modifying the hosts file.

logging.enabledDescription: Records blocked attempts and established connections to a CSV file, including which program made them. Off by default.
logging.pathDescription: Leave empty to use the default location under your local app data.
logging.intervalDescription: How often the log is updated. Logging polls, so anything shorter-lived than one interval can be missed.
logging.maxSizeDescription: In megabytes. When the log reaches this size it is renamed to .1 and a fresh one is started; only the one previous file is kept.
